instruction: For each bucket: set verdict to 'keep' or 'strike' on every row, and list any item you know demonstrates your construction that I missed. These are machine proposals from morph-it tagging of the reference translation. UNRATIFIED - nothing is written to any item until you return this packet.
semantics: expected_buckets is judged ONLY if the learner's answer engages it. Engaged and right = hit. Engaged and wrong = a real miss. Not engaged = blank, no penalty. So a GENEROUS list is safe; a WRONG list is not, because the marker will try to mark it.
do_not_prune_common: A bucket that fires on most items is NOT noise. Smith, 2026-08-11: the purpose is demonstrating knowledge - getting the definite article right 571 times is 571 pieces of evidence, and the learner should see 10 out of 12 correct even when the two the item was built for are wrong. Strike only what is WRONG, never what is merely frequent.

review_summary.headline: Morph-it is blind to the essere passive. è/sono/fu + participle = ordinary passato-prossimo morphology, so the commonest passive form was tagged ZERO times: the whole essere leaf (10 items) and the agent-da leaf (3) were missing from the packet, not merely under-tagged. Added both, with item lists, for the merge.
review_summary.one_strike: trans_tc_cf_coll_en_it_01 struck from BOTH passive and passive.formation.venire: 'venivo subito ad aiutare' is venire-as-motion in a counterfactual, not the passive auxiliary. The single morph false positive in the packet.
review_summary.not_added_and_why: trans_pas_it_en_use_03 (Italian is active 'hanno arrestato') and trans_pas_it_en_vsi_03 (pure si passivante 'si affittano camere') do NOT build the passive on the Italian side, so they stay out. The si-vs-passive items whose alternative reference IS a full passive (vsi_01 sono venduti, vsi_02 sono venduti dalla libreria) are added, since the learner CAN engage the passive there and an unengaged bucket is a harmless blank.
review_summary.note_to_architecture: passive.formation.essere and .agent_da are existing tree leaves; I am supplying which items demonstrate them, not minting buckets. Merge writes the expected_buckets. Recommend the morph pass, estate-wide, add an essere-passive heuristic (essere-aux + past participle agreeing with subject + optional da-phrase), or every topic that leans on the essere passive will have the same hole.
